files.speaker: ruby
files.text: You found the Heart Seed and became a person again! I’m Ruby.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Empress is beaten and Mint is free! Grandma’s recipes are down these pipes.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: So hot! This machine burns stolen flavor. Cocoa is free now!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The frozen mochi here were people once. Taro is free!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Crown root drinks this kitchen. Yuzu is here — let’s cut it!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The root slid into the garden. Grandma’s flavor is still in the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: These spores eat memories. Stay close to me!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The bees once made honey for everyone. Now they guard it for the Hunger.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Time stopped here when the curse began.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: All the roots lead to one place. The Hunger is growing a body.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The fields are empty. The Hunger is reaching for the First Tree.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: These flowers were eaten hollow. Stay sharp!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The glass shows the old kingdom. Look — people, not mochi!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The first seeds sleep here. The First Tree is close!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: This is the First Tree. Thank you for bringing me this far.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Long ago, a Crown turned everyone in Mochitopia into mochi — and began eating their flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: I’m Ruby, a jam spirit. Grandma made me to guard her recipe book and one sleeping seed.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Today the floor cracked, you fell, and the Heart Seed woke in your hands. You’re a person again!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Empress is free and her flavor came home. These pipes lead to where Grandma hid her jar.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Before the Hunger caught her, Grandma dropped her jar into the cracks to keep it safe.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Inside: Grandma’s Battle Recipes! Three seed styles for your Heart Seed; choose one on each floor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: This furnace burns the flavor the Hunger steals. Every spark is a piece of someone.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Look at those jars. Cursed mochi are trapped inside, drained of everything they are.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stop the furnace and their flavor comes home — then your seed can break their curse!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Cursed mochi are frozen in here as fuel. Their voices tremble beneath the frost.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: That gentle voice… Grandma! She froze herself so the Hunger could not eat her last page.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Her flavor is locked inside the Crown itself. We free the others now — then we go get hers.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Crown Oven. A root of the Crown comes up here to drink the whole kitchen’s flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: I’m frightened. But Grandma is waiting, and the First Tree is starving.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Let’s cut this root together. Then we follow it — all the way to the Crown.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stay alive until the timer ends. Keep moving!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Beat monsters to fill the Meter!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Keep the Wisp safe. Outside, you bleed!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stand inside the ring!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Protect the flower! Stay close.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Grab petals for all 4 seasons!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stand next to each root anchor to snap it!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Stay in the moving clean-air ring!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Dash into the glowing item to kick it at the boss!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Miniboss! Beat it to spin the reward wheel!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Boss! Dash away from red warnings, then hit back!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Magnet! It pulls in all your EXP.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Heal Mochi! Grab it to get HP back.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: A Treasure Chest! Open it for a free upgrade.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Depths is open! Use shovels to dig under the temple. Find the ladder to go deeper.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Rewards is open! Your daily login gift, Daily Quests and Awards are all here.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Bazaar is open! Open treasure chests and shop for gear with your Sugar and Thread.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Activities: daily goals and side fun that pay out rewards.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Daily Quests reset every day — finish them for reward boxes!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Awards count your big moments and pay Sugar for each one.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: News shows what changed in each update.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Mail keeps loot that did not fit your bag. Check it often!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Equipment! Put on the gear you find — it lives in the Upgrade tab.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Affix Forge lets you reroll the powers on your gear (Upgrade tab).

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Heroes! A new friend has joined — switch heroes and spend Talent points here.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Recipe Book remembers every Build card, relic and monster you meet.

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Poke me again. I dare you!

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Pew pew! Did you see that?

files.speaker: strawberry
files.text: Let’s go! My feet are bouncy!

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Chill. I’ve got your back.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Too hot? I can fix that.

files.speaker: mint
files.text: Brr! …That was me. Sorry.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Cookie? I always carry two.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Hide behind me, little one.

files.speaker: cocoa
files.text: Big hug or big punch? Pick!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Zap! …Mostly on purpose.

files.speaker: taro
files.text: My compass says: adventure!

files.speaker: taro
files.text: Ooh, sparkly! Can I touch it?

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Yuzlings! Look busy!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Tiny crew, big trouble!

files.speaker: yuzu
files.text: Citrus squad, roll out!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: If I stop obeying, who will keep my children safe?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: No! The crystal promised they would be safe!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Workers, stay behind me!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The orders are quiet… please, keep the eggs warm.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: You call it waste. I can still hear their names.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: I will not let another memory wash away!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The pipes are full. There is nowhere left to keep them!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The water is clear… I can hear each voice again.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: The stove must stay lit. Someone is still waiting for dinner.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Just one more tray. Then everyone can eat.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Why does every meal smell like smoke?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: At last… I can let the stove cool.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: If the ice melts, what will protect them from forgetting?

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Stay frozen. Stay safe. That was the order.

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Do not take the last shelter I can give them!

files.speaker: boss_c1
files.text: Their voices… they are warmer than I remember.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: A kingdom that cannot remember hunger can never complain.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: Give me the taste you are trying to save.

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: You cannot empty a hunger by feeding it!

files.speaker: hunger
files.text: You have cut one root. I have so many more.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Mother said I would bloom forever if I brought enough flavor.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not let my petals fall before she sees me!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Every spore carries a memory. I need them all!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Mother… was any of this garden ever mine?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: One heart cannot bear to lose another voice.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Stay together. No one leaves the colony!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Breathe with us. Forget the world outside!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: So many names… they can finally go home.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My workers brought this home. It has to be enough.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Every drop belongs in the royal stores!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not show my workers an empty flower!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The honey… we were feeding them the curse.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: One more moment. I can still save this day.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Spring will mend it. Winter will keep it. Again!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: If the hands stop, nothing else has to change!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Tomorrow… I had forgotten there could be a tomorrow.

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: I kept every voice alive. Why do they all ask to leave?

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: My roots have held this kingdom for centuries!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: Do not ask a mother to loosen her hold!

files.speaker: boss_c2
files.text: The one who planted me… he is still waiting.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: There must be one more row. Someone is still hungry.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: The granaries cannot be empty. I harvested everything!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Stand back. I have not finished the last row!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: The fields were green once… plant something for them.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: If I take just one more taste, perhaps I will feel it.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I remember sweetness. Why can I not taste yours?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Do not leave me empty again!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: So quiet… I can finally hear the orchard breathe.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Outside, everything breaks. Here, I can still keep them whole.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: That reflection is the kingdom before we failed it!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I will not let another future shatter!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Let them grow in the sun… even if the glass cannot follow.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: I know that seed. One has been missing all this time.

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: A closed vault cannot make another mistake!

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: If one seed changed everything, what might another do?

files.speaker: boss_c3
files.text: Then take them… plant them well. Do not keep them as I did.

files.speaker: planter
files.text: I wanted no one to go hungry. Tell me that was not wrong.

files.speaker: planter
files.text: I did it to feed the world! Why did their faces disappear?

files.speaker: planter
files.text: If I take it off, who will keep them safe from hunger?

files.speaker: planter
files.text: Every flavor… every person. I remember why I planted it now.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Long ago, Mochitopia was a kingdom of people — and every home was full of flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The First Planter set a Crown on the First Tree… and the Crown grew hungry.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: In one night, everyone became mochi — and the Crown began to eat their flavor.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Hundreds of years later, a little strawberry mochi is tidying a quiet pantry…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …when the starving Hunger’s roots burst up through the floor!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and a little strawberry mochi falls into the dark!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: She lands with a thump in a sour ant nest. Something pale is moving in the dark…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: Blank, flavorless mochi creep closer — toward a little jam spirit hiding behind a crystal.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: “This way!” squeaks Ruby. The two of them dash between the old roots.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: There, among the roots, something tiny is glowing — a sleeping seed.

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: The Heart Seed wakes at her touch…

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: …and the curse breaks. Strawberry is a person again!

files.speaker: ruby
files.text: “I’m Ruby, Grandma’s jam spirit! That seed can free everyone. Let’s go!”
